claims.claim: Generic sentences inflate importance by asserting legacy, pivotal moments and broader trends the sources do not support.
claims.source: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing (WikiProject AI Cleanup field guide)
claims.quote: marking a pivotal moment in the evolution of regional statistics
claims.page: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing (WikiProject AI Cleanup field guide)

claims.claim: Superlatives and brochure adjectives (nestled, breathtaking, vibrant) leak into what should be neutral description.
claims.source: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing (WikiProject AI Cleanup field guide)
claims.quote: Nestled within the breathtaking region of Gonder in Ethiopia
claims.page: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing (WikiProject AI Cleanup field guide)

claims.claim: Sentences end in a present-participle clause asserting significance with no supporting substance.
claims.source: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing (WikiProject AI Cleanup field guide)
claims.quote: further enhancing its significance as a dynamic hub
claims.page: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing (WikiProject AI Cleanup field guide)

claims.claim: Claims are hung on undefined authorities (industry reports, experts, some critics) instead of named sources.
claims.source: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing (WikiProject AI Cleanup field guide)
claims.page: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing (WikiProject AI Cleanup field guide)

claims.claim: Text characterises the independence and reach of its coverage instead of stating what happened.
claims.source: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing (WikiProject AI Cleanup field guide)
claims.page: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing (WikiProject AI Cleanup field guide)

claims.claim: Formulaic 'Despite X, faces challenges... future prospects' paragraphs close sections with vague solutions.
claims.source: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing (WikiProject AI Cleanup field guide)
claims.quote: Despite its success, the Panama Canal faces challenges
claims.page: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing (WikiProject AI Cleanup field guide)

claims.claim: Abnormal concentration of delve, pivotal, underscore, testament, enduring, tapestry within a short span.
claims.source: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing (WikiProject AI Cleanup field guide)
claims.page: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing (WikiProject AI Cleanup field guide)

claims.claim: Plain 'is/are' is replaced by serves as, functions as, stands as, marks.
claims.source: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing (WikiProject AI Cleanup field guide)
claims.quote: serves as LAAA's exhibition space for contemporary art
claims.page: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing (WikiProject AI Cleanup field guide)

claims.claim: 'Associated with', 'in connection with' replaces a named relation between people and events.
claims.source: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing (WikiProject AI Cleanup field guide)
claims.page: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing (WikiProject AI Cleanup field guide)

claims.claim: 'Not only X but also Y' and 'not X but Y' contrasts recur far above human frequency.
claims.source: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing (WikiProject AI Cleanup field guide)
claims.quote: not only a work of self-representation, but a visual document
claims.page: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing (WikiProject AI Cleanup field guide)

claims.claim: Lead sentences treat a list or descriptive title as if it named an entity.
claims.source: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing (WikiProject AI Cleanup field guide)
claims.quote: EuroGames editions is the chronological list
claims.page: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing (WikiProject AI Cleanup field guide)

claims.claim: A near-ubiquitous 'Awards and recognition' section appears in generated biographies regardless of subject.
claims.source: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing (WikiProject AI Cleanup field guide)
claims.page: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing (WikiProject AI Cleanup field guide)

claims.claim: Items are grouped in threes for rhythm rather than because the record has three.
claims.source: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing (WikiProject AI Cleanup field guide)
claims.page: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing (WikiProject AI Cleanup field guide)

claims.claim: Em dashes separate clauses at an abnormally high rate.
claims.source: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing (WikiProject AI Cleanup field guide)
claims.page: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing (WikiProject AI Cleanup field guide)

claims.claim: A redundant sentence summarising the section it closes (a 2022-2024 marker now mostly gone).
claims.source: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing (WikiProject AI Cleanup field guide)
claims.page: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing (WikiProject AI Cleanup field guide)
